description: This source file contains utility functions and handlers for MPU (Memory Protection Unit) and low-level hardware initialization and fault handling for STM32F7 microcontroller, including stack checking, fault vector handlers, and SPI initialization code.

methods.name: getRemainingStack
methods.description: Calculates and returns the remaining stack space for the given thread, based on the current context and stack pointer, with different implementations for GCC and IAR toolchains.

methods.name: baseHardwareInit
methods.description: Initializes hardware components, particularly resetting the cycle counter and setting the brown-out reset level.

methods.name: _unhandled_exception
methods.description: Handler for unhandled exceptions that triggers a panic and halts execution.

methods.name: DebugMonitorVector
methods.description: Handler for debug monitor vector, triggers a panic.

methods.name: UsageFaultVector
methods.description: Handler for usage faults, triggers a panic.

methods.name: BusFaultVector
methods.description: Handler for bus faults, triggers a panic.

methods.name: prvGetRegistersFromStack
methods.description: Collects CPU register states from the stack for post-mortem debugging after a fault.

methods.name: HardFaultVector
methods.description: Handler for hard faults; attempts to diagnose the cause and then halts.

methods.name: isUnderDebugger
methods.description: Evaluates if the system is running under debugger control.

methods.name: isValidCan1RxPin
methods.description: Checks if a given pin is valid for CAN1 receive.

methods.name: isValidCan1TxPin
methods.description: Checks if a given pin is valid for CAN1 transmit.

methods.name: isValidCan2RxPin
methods.description: Checks if a given pin is valid for CAN2 receive.

methods.name: isValidCan2TxPin
methods.description: Checks if a given pin is valid for CAN2 transmit.

methods.name: isValidCanTxPin
methods.description: Checks if a pin is valid for CAN transmit for either CAN1 or CAN2.

methods.name: isValidCanRxPin
methods.description: Checks if a pin is valid for CAN receive for either CAN1 or CAN2.

methods.name: detectCanDevice
methods.description: Detects which CAN device is connected based on the specified RX and TX pins.

methods.name: turnOnSpi
methods.description: Initializes and enables SPI for the specified device if not already initialized.

methods.name: initSpiModule
methods.description: Configures SPI module pins and settings for a given SPI driver.

methods.name: initSpiCs
methods.description: Initializes the chip select pin for SPI communication.

methods.name: BOR_Get
methods.description: Reads the current brown-out reset level from flash option bytes.

methods.name: BOR_Set
methods.description: Sets the brown-out reset level by updating flash option bytes.
